This template backs the "Report an issue" link generated by wikicommit-banner
on every published page (WikiCommitBanner.tsx). That link already pre-fills
the title (page type + title) and body (page URL + language) below, so if
you got here through that link you likely just need to describe the problem.

If you opened this template directly instead, please fill in the page URL
and language yourself.

The `wikicommit-report` label deliberately differs from the `wikicommit-review`
label used by WikiCommit's own review-tracking Issues, so the two never get
confused with each other.
